paragraphs.source_en:
S.’s focus on the macabre possibilities of these ‘shadows’ may be inspired by the fresco cycle at the
Campo Santo in Pisa, attributed to Buonamico Buffalmacco (active 1315–1336). Much of the cycle
was destroyed by bombing in 1944, but that which remains shows The Triumph of Death. This fresco
has all of the chaos of S.’s description, and features (on the left) a procession on horseback heading
towards coffins and (on the right) winged angels and demons snatching away humans from earth.
